typography.headline: font-headline (Existing display serif/geo-sans mix)
typography.kickers: uppercase tracking-[0.14em] text-xs or text-sm font-body text-[#E7E7F3]/70
rules: Use font-headline for all H1, H2, H3.
Use font-body for all paragraphs, labels, and UI text.
No generic 'Inter' feel. Emphasize serious scientific authority.
Line height: leading-none or leading-tight for headings, leading-relaxed for body.
No full-screen gradients. Use solid dark backgrounds with subtle structural borders.
Use Accent Green (#2BB673) for live tickers, node estimations, and success states.
Use Primary Violet (#5139ED) for primary CTAs and interactive hover states.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Grid Borders (Technical look). Container items use border-r border-b border-[#5139ED]/20 to expose the grid skeleton.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used ONLY for sticky SiteHeader and floating action bars. backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0F0E24]/70 border-b border-[#FAFAFF]/10.
visual_enhancers.glow: Subtle drop-shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(43,182,115,0.2)] for active states or live nodes.

grids_and_layouts.hero: Asymmetric split. Left: 7 columns (content). Right: 5 columns (HeroVisual canvas).
grids_and_layouts.modules_grid: Bento Grid Protocol (High Density). 3 columns on desktop. 1px solid borders, no border-radius (sharp) or max 8px.
grids_and_layouts.spacing: Generous. Section padding py-24 to py-32. Gap-8 to gap-12 in grids.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text meets APCA standards against the dark #0F0E24 background. Use text-[#FAFAFF] for primary, text-[#E7E7F3] for secondary.
accessibility.aria: Add aria-hidden='true' to decorative background networks.

motion.hover: Subtle transform -translate-y-0.5, border color transition 0.2s ease.
motion.entrance: Framer motion initial opacity-0 y-4, animate opacity-1 y-0, staggerChildren 0.1.
motion.hero_visual: Continuous slow panning or rotation of the network graph nodes.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: DO NOT use generic centered layouts. Prioritize left-aligned, asymmetrical structural grids.
DO NOT use default Inter font for headings. Use the existing font-headline.
Use data-testid on ALL interactive elements (buttons, links, inputs).
Preserve all existing routes and modal triggers.
Do not use transparent backgrounds under text. Use solid or glassmorphic backgrounds.
Create depth with layered elements (z-index) and subtle borders, not just shadows (shadows don't work well in dark mode, borders do).
Maintain serious scientific tone; avoid playful emoji or generic SaaS illustrations.
